Al franquear «{entrada}» se activa {etap: When “{entrada}” is cleared, {etapa} is activated, and since “{salida}” is already true it is cleared at the same instant too (transient evolution, IEC 60848). This often happens when the same push button is used to advance twice: use an edge ({flanco}) in the second transition or a different condition.

Botón GEMMA de la barra: marca los estad: GEMMA button on the toolbar: tick the states you use (A, F, D), their transitions and the forcing order each one applies to the production grafcet (e.g. D1: F/G1{}, A6: F/G1{INIT}). “Generate” creates the mode-control grafcet on the GEMMA sheet (frame GC). The production grafcet must be inside a frame with its name (G1).
Botón Ladder: una marca por etapa con SE: Ladder button: one memory bit per step with SET/RESET (initialization, clearing conditions, deactivation, activation, timers, stored actions and outputs). Exports the diagram (SVG, PNG, PDF) and the program in structured text (ST) and S7 STL (AWL).
Botón Simular. Etapa activa: verde con p: Simulate button. Active step: green with a dot. Enabled transition: amber; clearable: green. Emitted action: green. Inputs with a switch, a push button or keys 1–9; “Step” clears one at a time to watch the transient evolution.
Buscar en el diagrama: etapas, receptivi: Search the diagram: steps, receptivities, actions and notes (Ctrl+F)
Caja simple: activa mientras la etapa es: Plain box: on while the step is active.
Clic derecho sobre un enlace largo > «Co: Right click on a long link > “Cut with references”: it is drawn as an arrow under the origin (“to step 0”) and a stub above the destination (“from …”). It is still the same link for the simulation and the ladder.
Clic en una dirección o comentario para: Click an address or comment to edit it; drag a variable to another section to change its type; hovering a row highlights the nodes that use it.
Con una receptividad siempre verdadera l: With an always-true receptivity the step is deactivated at the same instant it is activated (transient evolution). According to IEC 60848, continuous actions are not executed in an unstable situation; only stored actions (on activation / on deactivation) are. Use a stored action or wait for a real condition.
Convierte una etapa en macroetapa (M1) y: Turn a step into a macro-step (M1) and draw its expansion in a frame named “M1” with an input step E1 and an output step S1. Activating M1 activates E1, and the transition after M1 can only be cleared when S1 is active.
Cuadrado con trazos arriba y abajo (M1…): Square with strokes above and below (M1…). It is detailed in another grafcet.
Cuadros de texto libres (barra o clic de: Free text boxes (toolbar or right click on the canvas). They are not part of the grafcet: verification, simulation and ladder ignore them. Format: “# Title”, “- item” for lists, **bold** between double asterisks and `Variable` between backticks.

OR divergence from step {etapa}: it could not be checked whether “{a}” and “{b}” are mutually exclusive (too many variables).
Doble cuadrado. Activa al arrancar; debe: Double square. Active at start-up; there must be at least one.

En la simulación, «Grabar escenario» ano: During simulation, “Record scenario” logs input changes with their time; they are saved in the project and replayed with one click (at the chosen speed). The full timing chart is exported as SVG or CSV.

Pestañas abajo del lienzo: + añade una h: Tabs below the canvas: + adds a sheet, double click renames it. With several elements selected, right click > “Move to…”. Links between sheets are drawn as references (“to step 5 (Sheet 2)”). Simulation, ladder and Verify see all sheets; when exporting to PDF you can choose “All sheets”.
Receptividad «1» después de {etapas}, qu: Receptivity “1” after {etapas}, which has continuous actions: they will never be executed.
Selecciona etapas y, con el botón derech: Select steps and, with the right button, “Enclose in a partial grafcet” (frame G1, G2...). An action F/G2{3} forces G2 to have only step 3 active while the step lasts; F/G2{} empties it, F/G2{*} freezes it and F/G2{INIT} resets it. A forced grafcet does not evolve.
Selecciona varios nodos y, con clic dere: Select several nodes and, with right click: Align in a column or Space the sequence (standard distances).
t/Xn cuenta el tiempo desde que se activ: t/Xn counts the time since step n was activated and goes back to 0 when it is deactivated. Usually the timed step is the one preceding the transition ({propuesta}); if you really want to time another step, it is fine as it is.
Tabla de variables: direcciones de PLC d: Variables table: PLC addresses of steps, inputs and outputs
Transición sin receptividad: toda transi: Transition without a receptivity: every transition needs one (use 1 if it is always true).
Trazo horizontal con su receptividad a l: Horizontal bar with its receptivity on the right. Use 1 if it is always true.
Vertical stroke above with the condition. With a time (3s/X2) it is delayed.
un flanco necesita un cambio: todavía no: an edge needs a change: there has been none yet
Una acción continua asigna la salida en: A continuous action assigns the output at every instant (1 while the step is active, 0 otherwise); a stored action leaves it at a value until another one changes it. Mixing both on the same output makes the continuous one override the stored one. Choose a single kind for each output.
Una entrada comparada con números (Tempe: An input compared with numbers (Temperature > 60) is analog. In Variables you choose its signal (4–20 mA or 0–10 V) and its physical range; the simulation uses a slider in those units and the PLC program compares with the precomputed raw value (e.g. AIW0 > 21760).
Una etapa con varias transiciones altern: A step with several alternative transitions: single line under the step.
A receptivity of 0 blocks the sequence. Write the condition that must be met to advance.
Una receptividad describe lo que se espe: A receptivity describes what is expected from the process: usually inputs (sensors, push buttons) or the state of other steps (X3). An output is set by the grafcet itself, so waiting for it is usually an oversight: use the sensor that confirms the order has been carried out. If it is an internal flag, change its type to “Memory” in Variables.
Una transición que activa varias etapas: A transition that activates several steps at once: double line.
Validada y con la receptividad verdadera: Enabled and with a true receptivity: it is cleared in the next cycle.
X{etapa} no está activa: la temporizació: X{etapa} is not active: the timer is not counting
X2 vale 1 con la etapa 2 activa (IEC 608: X2 is 1 while step 2 is active (IEC 60848). In Variables you can choose for the table, the ladder, ST, STL and the simulation to use E2; in receptivities you still write X2 and 5s/X2.
